acceptance: Every Trunk push run on develop created 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-24 whose first or latest attempt failed is listed with run id, attempts and outcomes, failing job, and one cause from the stated set; the table is recorded on this item
Stale-base composition failures are counted per week and compared with the about-once-a-week threshold; if exceeded, an owner decision on reinstating the up-to-date requirement is requested
Each recurring cause (two or more runs) has an item, existing or new, linked here

The classification states how the red-trunk gate and arm gate (trunk-red-stops-further-merges, trunk-arm-gate-blames-newest-red-run-20261022) treated these runs, and whether that explains reds clearing without a revert
context: Source: independent review of the PR-checks versus Trunk split on 2026-10-24 (develop a56738db4; run history 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-24: 465 merges, 466 Trunk push runs; Trunk coverage push runs only exist from 2026-10-21). Run logs expire after about 90 days, so the classification must be done before 2027-01-08.
description: 59 of 466 Trunk push runs on develop (12.7%) failed between 2026-10-10 and 2026-10-24, on 13 of 15 days, each on a different merged PR, but only 2 PRs titled Revert merged. The documented policy is revert-first with a red-trunk gate on make pr-open, so most reds cleared some other way. Run lists show only the latest attempt, so first inspect every attempt of each run. Classify each red run as: flaky (passed on rerun or failed without a code cause), Python 3.12 only (PR fast runs on 3.14 at ci.yml:867, Trunk fast on 3.12 at trunk.yml:33), stale-base composition between concurrent squash merges, real regression reverted, or real regression fixed forward. Count stale-base composition failures against the governance threshold (more than about one a week means reinstating the up-to-date requirement; develop rulesets currently have strict_required_status_checks_policy false and no merge queue). This classification is the baseline that coverage selection needs before going live; the rate target lives in trunk-red-rate-target-20261024.
